description: Starts rendering short promo clips of a workout or program in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1. Use when the user wants teaser videos for social, a website or an app store. Not for a full-length video (use export_workout_video) or a ready-to-post social drop (use create_drop). Returns a progress card that updates until the clips are ready.

force_new.description: true = render again from scratch, e.g. after a failed render or an edit. Defaults to false (reuse a matching render).

id.description: ID of the workout or program. Get it from list_team_workouts or list_team_programs.

locale.description: Language of the clips, e.g. "en-US". Workouts only; program clips use the team default. Omit for the team default.

type.description: What to act on: workout = a single workout; program = a multi-week program.

name: generate_clips
title: Generate short clips
